hash-text.title: Hash Text
hash-text.description: Compute the MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512, SHA3 or RIPEMD160 hash of a text

id-generator.title: UUID / ULID Generator
id-generator.description: Generate UUID v1–v7, Nil and ULID in five spellings and four join styles, and decode any ID back to its version, variant and timestamp
id-generator.error-timestamp: Timestamp must be a non-negative integer of milliseconds
id-generator.error-namespace: Custom namespace must be a valid UUID
id-generator.error-name: Named UUIDs need a non-empty name

uuid.one-shot: Same input, same output — one per run
uuid.name: Name (hashed byte by byte)
uuid.hint-v4: 122 random bits, the usual primary key
uuid.hint-v7: Leads with a 48-bit millisecond clock, sorts by time
uuid.hint-v1: Carries node and clock sequence; browsers use a random node
uuid.hint-v5: SHA-1 name-based, same name yields the same UUID
uuid.hint-v3: MD5 name-based, kept for legacy systems

parse.input: Paste IDs (one per line, or a whole batch)
parse.input-hint: Accepts hyphenated, bare, braced, urn:uuid: and ULID forms
parse.row-limit: Showing the first {{shown}} rows, counts cover the whole batch
parse.error-length: Wrong length: a UUID is 32 hex digits, a ULID is 26 characters
parse.error-character: Illegal character: UUIDs allow 0-9 a-f only, ULID's Crockford Base32 omits I, L, O and U

bcrypt.title: Bcrypt Hash
bcrypt.description: Hash a password with bcrypt or verify a plaintext against an existing hash, with adjustable cost rounds, computed entirely in your browser.
bcrypt.mismatch: The password does not match the hash

encryption.title: Text Encryption
encryption.description: Encrypt and decrypt text with AES-256-GCM and a PBKDF2-derived key; legacy AES-CBC ciphertext can still be decrypted. Nothing leaves your machine.
encryption.decryptFailed: Decryption failed: wrong key or invalid ciphertext
encryption.legacyNotice: This cipher text uses the legacy AES-CBC format and was opened for you. Re-encrypt it once with the current version: the new format is authenticated, so any tampering makes decryption fail outright.
encryption.insecureContext: This page is not a secure context (https or localhost is required), so the browser has disabled WebCrypto and the new format is unavailable. Legacy AES-CBC cipher text can still be decrypted here.

password-strength-analyser.title: Password Strength Analyser
password-strength-analyser.description: Generate random strong passwords and score an existing one by charset coverage, entropy and estimated offline or online crack time, locally.

gen.title: Random Password Generator
gen.excludeAmbiguous: Exclude ambiguous characters (i l 1 L o 0 O)
gen.summary: {{total}} characters final · {{entropy}} bit effective entropy in the random part

errors.emptyPool: Enable at least one character type with usable characters
errors.lengthOutOfRange: Length must be an integer between {{min}} and {{max}}
errors.countOutOfRange: Count must be an integer between {{min}} and {{max}}
errors.minExceedsLength: The sum of per-type minimums exceeds the random part length

password-strength-analyser.disclaimer: Estimates assume 10^10 brute-force guesses per second, for strength reference only

passphrase-generator.title: Passphrase Generator
passphrase-generator.description: Pick random words from a built-in list to build a memorable Diceware-style passphrase, with word count, separators, capitalization and a random digit, plus its theoretical entropy.
passphrase-generator.entropyHint: {{words}} words from a {{size}}-word list, plus 4 bit for the digit
passphrase-generator.disclaimer: Passphrases are generated in your browser only — nothing is uploaded or stored locally.

file-hash-checker.title: File Hash Checker
file-hash-checker.description: Drop any file to compute its MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests at once and verify them against an expected hash, without leaving your machine.
file-hash-checker.dropLabel: Drag a file here, or click to browse
file-hash-checker.dropHint: Any file type, read locally in your browser
file-hash-checker.dropNote: Files are never uploaded or written to local storage
file-hash-checker.expectedPlaceholder: Paste a checksum; case and spaces are ignored
file-hash-checker.matchHint: Comparison ignores letter case and whitespace
file-hash-checker.hashFailed: Reading or hashing failed, please try another file
file-hash-checker.disclaimer: Everything is computed locally in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

pdf-signature-checker.title: PDF Signature Checker
pdf-signature-checker.description: Read digital signatures in a PDF: signer, certificate chain and validity, signing time and digest algorithm, and whether the file changed after signing.
pdf-signature-checker.dropHint: Drag a PDF file here, or click to browse

warning.unsigned-signature-field: A signature field exists, but its ByteRange is a placeholder or invalid (signature not completed)
warning.invalid-byte-range: Invalid ByteRange dictionary or out of file range
warning.modified-after-signing: Signed ranges do not cover the whole file; it may have been modified after signing

pdf-signature-checker.disclaimer: Basic byte-level check only; it does not constitute legal verification

key-generator.title: Key Generator
key-generator.description: Generate HMAC secrets, RSA / ECDSA / Ed25519 key pairs and symmetric keys, exported to PEM, OpenSSH, JWK and fingerprints
key-generator.warning-private-key: This page holds private keys. Everything is computed in your browser — nothing is uploaded or stored locally.

keypair.hint: RSA-4096 takes about 0.2s; Ed25519 is shorter and faster, recommended for SSH and new protocols

unavailable.no-ssh: This algorithm has no OpenSSH representation
unavailable.no-traditional-pem: This algorithm has no PKCS#1 / SEC1 traditional format
unavailable.no-raw-seed: This key is not represented by a single seed; use PKCS#8

hmac.hint: RFC 2104: the key should be at least as long as the digest; longer keys are hashed first

token.errorCharset: Select at least one character set

hmac-calculator.title: HMAC Calculator
hmac-calculator.description: Compute an HMAC digest with SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-384 / SHA-512 from a text, hex or Base64 key, then copy the result or compare it with an expected value.
hmac-calculator.key-placeholder: Enter a key; it is interpreted using the encoding below
hmac-calculator.message-placeholder: Enter the message to compute the HMAC of
hmac-calculator.expected-placeholder: Paste an expected digest to compare
hmac-calculator.mismatch: Does not match the expected value
hmac-calculator.error: Computation failed: the key is empty or the encoding is invalid
hmac-calculator.disclaimer: Everything is computed locally in your browser; keys and messages are never uploaded.

x509-certificate-decoder.title: X.509 Certificate Decoder
x509-certificate-decoder.description: Paste a PEM or base64-encoded DER certificate to inspect its version, serial number, issuer and subject, validity, public key, SAN extensions and TBS fingerprint, all locally.
x509-certificate-decoder.input-placeholder: PEM starting with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- or base64-encoded DER
x509-certificate-decoder.empty: Paste a certificate to decode it automatically
x509-certificate-decoder.error: Unable to parse this certificate; check that it is complete and well-formed
x509-certificate-decoder.subject: Subject
x509-certificate-decoder.disclaimer: Decoding happens locally in your browser; the certificate is never uploaded.

ssh-key-fingerprint.title: SSH Key Fingerprint
ssh-key-fingerprint.description: Paste an OpenSSH public key to compute its SHA256 and MD5 fingerprints and read its key type and size, matching ssh-keygen -l output.
ssh-key-fingerprint.empty: Paste a public key line from authorized_keys to compute its fingerprints
ssh-key-fingerprint.error: Unable to parse this key; make sure you pasted a .pub public key rather than a private key
ssh-key-fingerprint.copy-hint: The SHA256 fingerprint is standard unpadded Base64, identical to ssh-keygen -l output.
ssh-key-fingerprint.disclaimer: Everything is computed locally in your browser; the public key is never uploaded.

pkce-generator.title: PKCE Generator
pkce-generator.description: Generate RFC 7636 code_verifier and S256 / plain code_challenge values for the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, with all randomness produced locally.
pkce-generator.hint: The verifier is 43–128 URL-safe characters; S256 hashes it with SHA-256 and encodes the digest as Base64URL.
pkce-generator.method-hint-s256: Recommended: the authorization server only sees the challenge and cannot derive the verifier.
pkce-generator.method-hint-plain: plain sends the verifier as-is in the authorization request; only use it for legacy servers without S256.
pkce-generator.error: Generation failed: the verifier must be 43–128 URL-safe characters
pkce-generator.disclaimer: The verifier is generated in your browser only — nothing is uploaded or written to local storage.

identifier-validator.title: Identifier Validator
identifier-validator.description: Validate credit card numbers (Luhn plus brand detection), IMEI, IBAN and ISBN-10 / ISBN-13 locally, auto-detecting the kind and returning a normalized value.
identifier-validator.input-placeholder: Paste a card number, IBAN or ISBN; spaces and hyphens are allowed
identifier-validator.empty: Enter a number to detect and validate it automatically
identifier-validator.disclaimer: Only the format and check digit are verified; no issuer or institution database is queried.

hash-identifier.title: Hash Identifier
hash-identifier.description: Infer the likely hash type from its length and prefix (bcrypt, Argon2, PBKDF2, MD5, SHA family, CRC32, Base64) with a confidence level and the reasoning.
hash-identifier.input-placeholder: Paste a hash, e.g. $2b$12$… or a 64-character hex string
hash-identifier.empty: Enter a hash to identify the possible algorithms

reasons.bcrypt-prefix: bcrypt modular crypt format starting with $2a$ / $2b$ / $2y$
reasons.pbkdf2-prefix: Starts with $pbkdf2$ or a pbkdf2_sha256$ style prefix

hash-identifier.disclaimer: This is a format-based guess only; equal lengths do not prove equal algorithms, so trust the original source.
